description: Main cast. Every character marked unique should appear at most once in a frame; two instances of the same unique character in one frame is a duplicate-character artifact.

characters.name: Suzie
characters.features: red-brown fur, big bushy tail, purple eyes, brass goggles with a purple strap on her head, cream t-shirt, orange overalls with yellow and purple buttons and a twig, purple sneakers

references.note: character sheet: front, side, back, thinking, surprised

characters.name: Raccoon
characters.features: grey fur with black eye mask, brown eyes, striped tail, red hoodie, dark plaid backpack, charcoal joggers, black and red sneakers

references.note: character sheet: front, left, back, right, neutral, cheerful

characters.name: Turtle
characters.features: young turtle, lime-green skin with darker scale patches, brown eyes, navy baseball cap worn backwards, royal-blue t-shirt, black shorts with white stripes, black sneakers, shell-pattern backpack, often holds a soccer ball

references.note: character sheet: front, left, back, right, neutral, cheerful

characters.notLike: an elderly grey-green turtle with a real shell and no cap is a different (supporting) character

characters.name: Felix
characters.features: brown fur with cream muzzle, floppy ears, amber eyes, heavy brows, often irritated or unimpressed, black cap worn backwards, grey t-shirt with a skateboard graphic, black track pants with white stripes, black sneakers, dark plaid backpack with red trim

references.note: character sheet: front, left, back, right, irritated, unimpressed
earlier design of Felix (confirmed same character): green eyes, one pointed ear, same outfit

characters.features: beige fur, long lop ears with pink insides, purple bow, round purple glasses, blue eyes, purple hoodie with a white tree logo, black track pants with white stripes, purple sneakers, purple-and-olive plaid backpack; sometimes a purple cardigan over a cream collared dress; carries a tablet

references.note: character sheet: front, left, back, right, neutral, cheerful
alternate outfit: purple cardigan over cream dress

characters.name: Otter
characters.features: chocolate-brown fur, cream muzzle, whiskers, brown eyes, brown t-shirt with white trim, navy shorts with white stripes, dark sneakers, navy-and-olive backpack, blue water bottle
